def fact : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => (n+1) * fact n

def sumFacts (S : List Nat) : Nat := S.map fact |>.sum

def checkL1 : Bool :=
  sumFacts [1, 4] == 25 && sumFacts [2, 3] == 8

theorem w25 : 25 = fact 1 + fact 4 := by decide
theorem w8 : 8 = fact 2 + fact 3 := by decide
